root.description: The id of the root the path is under

repository.description: The repository the path belongs to, relative to the analysis root: `''` for the repository the root is in

path.description: The path, relative to its root: a tracked file present in the worktree, or an untracked file no ignore rule covers; a symlink is one listed name, nothing beneath a directory link. Never an ignored file, a tracked file deleted from the worktree, a skip-worktree file absent from disk, or a submodule's gitlink

projection-git-content.description: A row of the derived `git_content` relation
